== .schema_status_descs ==
next	Clarified and ready to do
waiting	Blocked on someone else
inbox	Captured but not yet clarified
someday	Parked for later consideration
done	Completed
dropped	Intentionally removed

== .schema_status_filter_cycle ==
inbox
next
waiting
someday
done

== .schema_status_fwd ==
next	done
waiting	next
inbox	next
someday	next
done	inbox
dropped	inbox

== .schema_status_initial ==
inbox
== .schema_status_order ==
nextwaitinginboxsomedaydonedropped
== .schema_status_rev ==
next	inbox
waiting	inbox
inbox	someday
someday	dropped
done	next
dropped	someday
